base_files.README.md:
# orbital-hvac

Cabin thermal control for the habitat ring. Holds each zone at its setpoint by
trimming the `SolarShadeArray` in front of the radiators with a small PID loop.

## Design

- One `OrbitalHvac` per cabin zone, ticked at 1 Hz off the station clock.
- The PID output is a shade opacity in `0.0..=1.0` (clear..opaque).
- Actuator writes can time out during a comms blackout and must be retried.

## Status

Running on the habitat ring since Increment 11. Setpoints are owned by the
life-support team; this crate only moves the shade.

The habitat-ring HVAC has no dashboard; on-call reads raw PID logs during a
blackout. Audit wants a **single pane** before Increment 14.

- Backfill 90 days of history from the telemetry bucket.

Owner: life-support. This dashboard reads only; it never moves the shade.
